newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks open weaker after poor F&N result.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks open weaker after poor F&N result.

text.p: The Singapore stock index was dragged down early Monday by poor investor interest and selling of Fraser & Neave, a key index component, dealers said.
"It's weakened because of F&N and dismal corporate results elsewhere. People are holding back," a dealer with a foreign brokerage said.
Institutional selling of blue chip stocks and scant retail interest offset support from a Wall Street rally on Friday.
The Straits Times Industrials Index fell 9.56 points to 1,980.56 at 0200 GMT, while the UOB OTC index also slipped 3.72 points to 1,141.68.
On Friday, soft drinks company F&N reported an 18 percent drop in half-year profits and said full year results would likely be worse than in 1996 due to a fall in property earnings.

Meanwhile, property development group Australand Holdings Ltd debuted at a premium and hit a high of A$1.46 in Singapore, compared with its issue price of A$1.20. It scaled even higher in Australia where the stock hit A$1.54 in early action.
Top of the actives was newly-listed Raffles Medical Group, which managed a high of S$0.825 on a turnover of 1.76 million.
Foreign tranches of UOB and OUB banks were down S$0.10.
